rows.claim: Each `worker-run wait` poll tick (every WAIT_POLL = 5 s, about 720 ticks per hour) re-reads the whole transcript twice whenever it has grown, which it does on nearly every tick while a worker is active. That prints the same new rows in the same order and writes the same total to `tokens`, which statusline-work-probe.sh reads. Leave the slurping vendors on the full pass, or at least start the token count less often. Aggregate saving: about 2 full transcript parses plus 1 python3 start per 5 s tick for each waiting chat; elapsed time on the critical path is unchanged.
